---
title: "Curating the data, part 1: Finn the Wolfhound"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(gutenbergr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r load-data}

if (!dir.exists(here("data"))) {
  dir.create(here("data"))
}

if (!file.exists(here("data/finn.rda"))) {
     
     finn <- gutenberg_download(30550)
    
     save(finn, file=here("data/finn.rda"))
} else {

     load(here("data/finn.rda"))
}
```


```{r }

finn <- finn |> mutate(row_number = row_number())

# Subset the data to remove the Gutenberg intro and outro.

finn_trimmed <- finn |> 
  filter(row_number > 50 & row_number < 15000)
```
```{r}
sample(finn)
```

```{r}
table_of_contents <- finn |>
                     filter(row_number >= 20 & row_number <= 45) |>
                     filter(text != "")
```
```{r}
# add the indicator for younger audiences
table_of_contents <- table_of_contents |>
                     mutate(younger = substr(text, 1, 1) == "*")
```
```{r}
table_of_contents <- table_of_contents |>
  mutate(
    title = "Title",
    # Anything containing the word "CHAPTER" is the main story, otherwise it's front/back matter
    text_type = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "CHAPTER") ~ "Story",
      TRUE ~ "Front/Back Matter"
    )
  )
```
```{r}
# Match the TOC strings to the strings in the trimmed book
table_of_contents |>
  rename(toc_row = row_number) |>
  select(-gutenberg_id)  |>
  left_join(finn_trimmed, by = "text") |>
  rename(title_row = row_number) ->
  table_of_contents

# Number the titles (Finn the Wolfhound likely doesn't have epigraphs, but this sets it up just in case)
table_of_contents <- table_of_contents |> 
  group_by(text) |> 
  mutate(title_number = row_number(),
         title_type = "main") |> 
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(section_title = text)
```

```{r}
finn_trimmed <- finn_trimmed |>
  left_join(table_of_contents,
             by = join_by( "text" == "text",
                           "row_number" == "title_row",
                           "gutenberg_id" == "gutenberg_id")) |>
  arrange(row_number)
```
```{r}

# Fill the missing metadata down the rows
finn_trimmed <- finn_trimmed |> 
  mutate(title = ifelse(is.na(title) == TRUE, "Text", "Title")) |>
  fill(text_type) |> 
  fill(title_type) |>
  fill(section_title) 

save(finn_trimmed, file = here("data/finn_trimmed.rda"))
```
